panel.title: WaylandBetterVoice
panel.no_keybinds: No shortcuts found in your niri config. See packaging/niri-keybinds.kdl.

settings.electron_mode_desc: Off types instantly in normal Wayland apps. Turn on for Electron apps such as VS Code, Discord, and Termius.
settings.overlay_margin_desc: Pixels below the top of the screen so the overlay clears the bar (default 46).
settings.orb_scale_desc: Size multiplier for the dictation orb cluster (default 1.0).
settings.show_transcribing_desc: Keep the orb visible during the transcribing phase (calmer palette).
settings.meeting_pill_desc: Screen-share safe dim pill with elapsed timer while a meeting is active.
settings.icon_color_desc: Tint of the bar mic icon when idle (mode still overrides while active).
